program.goal: Extend the vv spec-plan-execute pipeline with an orthogonal cross-scope impact axis, a host-executed deletion census, deterministic lint teeth, and a program tier, so a large intra-domain refactoring does not cascade into an operator-driven waterfall. Validate against the foundation CURRICULUM counterfactual (schools deletion surface, examinations DI witness).

C-ARTIFACT-SCHEMAS.name: Artifact XML templates
C-ARTIFACT-SCHEMAS.responsibility: impact / paths / program / plan-deletes templates (unique-tag, no attributes)

C-CENSUS-ENGINE.name: spec_guard_census implementation
C-CENSUS-ENGINE.responsibility: TS compiler API over worktree; DI-aware usage; edge kinds; canonical digest; partition; lifecycle

C-LINT-ENFORCEMENT.name: Lint enforcement
C-LINT-ENFORCEMENT.responsibility: generation-gap fix + CDATA parser + new cross-scope rules + archive calibration

C-SPEC-SKILL.name: vv-spec skill wiring
C-SPEC-SKILL.responsibility: impact section + paths + SCOPE_IMPACT interview step + decomposition gate

C-PLAN-SKILL.name: vv-plan skill wiring
C-PLAN-SKILL.responsibility: deletes/renames + consumer-coverage + scope-barrier waves + behavioral ACs (surface/policy)

C-EXECUTE-FEEDBACK.name: Execution feedback
C-EXECUTE-FEEDBACK.responsibility: reason codes + ADD-NNN addendum + AMEND-GRANT + pre-flight re-census + undeclared-deletion + goal-attainment closeout

C-PANEL.name: Panel + v2 items
C-PANEL.responsibility: impact chip + program rollup + weighted threshold / transitive / submodule census

P-P0.title: P0 — schema-contract seam
P-P0.seam-contract: Artifact XML templates + census-contract.json + lint-rules.json. Additive only; no SKILL.md/plugin code/profile change. P1-P4 consume these schemas.

P-P1.title: P1 — spec-guard enforcement
P-P1.seam-contract: spec_guard_census tool (per census-contract.json) + lint rules (per lint-rules.json) + CDATA-aware parseXmlLite + generation-gap fix. cross-scope-fanout ships WARN; archive calibration before ERROR. First validation: examinations DI runtime-import witness at af92a878^.

P-P2.title: P2 — vv-spec skill wiring
P-P2.seam-contract: vv-spec loads impact/paths/program templates; SCOPE_IMPACT interview step; decomposition gate (WARN recorded choice / ERROR program). work-item reference check is an interview step here.

P-P3.title: P3 — vv-plan skill wiring
P-P3.seam-contract: vv-plan loads deletes template; task scope + consumer-coverage + scope-barrier waves; behavioral ACs for surface/policy; cascade-concentration + consumer-coverage rules.

P-P4.title: P4 — execution feedback + review
P-P4.seam-contract: SCOPE_CASCADE_DISCOVERED reason code + impact-addendum (ADD-NNN) + AMEND-GRANT + pre-flight stale-impact + undeclared-deletion + goal-attainment closeout + review dispatch naming consumer entry files.

P-P5.title: P5 — panel + v2 items (optional)
P-P5.seam-contract: impact fan-out chip + addendum-pending state (delivered); full program rollup + weighted threshold / transitive census / submodule census (v2) deferred. Deferrable polish.

invariants.INV-1: Host computes, author declares, lint compares. Census counts/edges/digest are host output, never author prose.
invariants.INV-2: lint.ts verdict engine stays zero-dependency and never touches the filesystem; the census is a separate host tool (typescript runtime dep + worktree). Host passes censusDigest into SpecLintOptions.
invariants.INV-3: Unique-tag, no attributes; identity in the tag name; generic repeating children forbidden (pairing-lossy).
invariants.INV-4: P0 is additive only: no existing SKILL.md, plugin code, or profile is modified by the schema seam.
invariants.INV-5: cross-scope-fanout ships WARN and flips to ERROR only after archive calibration confirms it fires on the schools deletion surface, not on local-feature noise. ERROR forces program (no override grant).
invariants.INV-6: Worktree ref-pinning: mirror pnpm per-entry relative links; forbid wholesale live-node_modules symlink; resolve baselineRef to OID first; digest pins analyzer version + resolutionStrategy.

program.sequencing: P0 seam first (schemas + rule names + census contract). P1 implements enforcement against P0 schemas. P2 wires vv-spec, P3 wires vv-plan (after P2), P4 wires execution feedback (after P3). P5 panel + v2 items are the optional tail after P1/P4. Contract-first: P0 freezes the substrate so P1-P4 are parallelizable and integration is deterministic.
